# Hash-pinned requirements (cycle 217).
#
# Install with: python -m pip install --require-hashes -r <this file>
# Regenerate per cycle at latest versions (pip --dry-run --report
# against the matching pyproject extra, then this generator), and
# keep Dependabot's pip entry for tools/requirements/ enabled so
# pins move weekly. Never hand-edit a version without regenerating
# its hashes: pip verifies every downloaded artifact against them.


#
# Multi-target note (cycle 217 fix): this file serves Python
# 3.11/3.12/3.13. networkx and numpy are marker-split because their
# latest releases declare Requires-Python >=3.12: the >=3.12 line
# carries the latest pin, the <3.12 line the newest release that
# still admits 3.11. Regeneration must re-check every pin's
# Requires-Python against all three interpreters.
# Cycle 228 (audit B-04): typer requires colorama on Windows
# (platform_system == "Windows"); a metadata sweep found the line
# missing — a Linux resolution never sees it. It is maintained by
# hand with the parent's own marker.
# W3 (RR-07): torch 2.15.0 gates its CUDA cluster on Linux in its
# own Requires-Dist (platform_system == "Linux"); a Linux resolution
# flattens that gate into unconditional pins. The 18 cluster lines
# (cuda-bindings, cuda-toolkit, the nvidia-* pins and triton) are
# maintained by hand with upstream's marker. cuda-pathfinder is a
# pure wheel and is deliberately unmarked.
